body: character reference sheet T-POSE, straight-on front view -- a chibi VOXEL-BLOCK toy figure of a mecha robot with BOTH ARMS LOCKED COMPLETELY STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height like a scarecrow (elbows perfectly straight, NOT bent, NOT hanging down, NOT resting near the hips -- each arm forms one continuous straight horizontal line from the shoulder to the fingertips), both blocky mechanical hands open with a large visible gap of empty background between each hand and the torso, nothing held, fully visible in frame. Big blocky head, stocky blocky body, made of assembled rectangular blocks, every part a flat rectangular block with hard 90-degree edges, bold thick black outline stroke around every edge, flat hard-contrast shading. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart, nothing overlapping the torso or limbs. Matte dark gunmetal-charcoal blocky mech armor with thick YELLOW-GREEN trim block accents, a blocky robot head block with two flat glowing YELLOW-GREEN rectangular eyes, a blocky chest panel block with a glowing yellow-green display, a wrench block holstered flat on the back (not in either hand). Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, generous empty margin so nothing is cropped, no text, no logos, no watermark

character reference sheet T-POSE, straight-on front view -- a chibi VOXEL-BLOCK toy figure of a hooded mystic with BOTH ARMS LOCKED COMPLETELY STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height like a scarecrow (elbows perfectly straight, NOT bent downward, each arm forms one continuous straight horizontal line from the shoulder to the fingertips, the sleeve does not droop or bunch), both blocky hands open with fingers spread and clearly extending past the sleeve cuffs, a large visible gap of empty background between each hand and the torso, nothing held, the hood does not cover the arms, fully visible in frame. Big blocky head, short stubby blocky body, made of assembled rectangular blocks, every part a flat rectangular block with hard 90-degree edges, bold thick black outline stroke around every edge, flat hard-contrast shading. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart, nothing overlapping the torso or limbs. Matte dark navy-charcoal blocky hooded robe with thick VIOLET-PURPLE trim block accents, a blocky pointed hood block shadowing the face with two flat glowing green rectangular eyes, a glowing violet gem block on the chest, a small book block on the belt (not in either hand). Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, generous empty margin so nothing is cropped, no text, no logos, no watermark
